args.content: Working definition: The 'leading region' is the region (from memory.bench.customers.region) whose customers placed the most orders. To compute it, join memory.bench.orders to memory.bench.customers on customer_id, count orders grouped by region, and take the region with the highest order count. Apply this definition consistently in future analyses that reference "the leading region."
